title: Implementation Evidence (entry snapshot and diff)
description: Structure reference for the two script-generated implementation evidence files. $defs.base describes openspec/changes/<change-id>/design/evidence/implementation-base.json written by scripts/implementation-snapshot.py at the start of stage 08. $defs.diff describes openspec/changes/<change-id>/design/evidence/implementation-diff.json written by scripts/check-change-footprint.py at the end of stage 08 and independently recomputed at stage 09. JSON evidence is generated by scripts only; never hand-write it.

head.description: git rev-parse HEAD value at capture time.

files.description: Workspace-relative path of every counted file mapped to its SHA-256 after the shared exclusion rules are applied.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the canonical files JSON.

override_reason.description: Optional. Required when --force overwrites an existing snapshot.

base_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint copied from the matching implementation-base.json.

sha256.description: Content SHA-256 pinning this diff entry: the current file hash for added/modified paths, the implementation-base.json hash for deleted paths.

diff_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sorted canonical changed_paths JSON (each entry's path, status and content sha256).
